workarounds.symptom: s14: MCP handler defaults can be overridden by tool input, bypassing host policy
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: keep tool input from overriding the MCP handler's tool. Target files: s14_mcp_plugin/code.py, s15_integrated_harness/code.py, tests/test_agent_teams_runtime.py. `assemble_tool_pool()` built each MCP handler as a lambda whose `client` and `tool` were ordinary keyword parameters carrying defaults: (Ref: https://github.com/shareAI-lab/learn-claude-code/pull/613)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] extract-content.ts crashes on Windows: fs.cpSync aborts tsx with 0xC0000409
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(web): replace fs.cpSync to avoid Windows crash in extract step. Target files: web/scripts/extract-content.ts. Replaces the single `fs.cpSync` call in `web/scripts/extract-content.ts` with a small recursive copy helper. (Ref: https://github.com/shareAI-lab/learn-claude-code/pull/574)

workarounds.symptom: s16：一个并行分支失败后，journal 提前关闭，其他 Agent 的成功结果无法保存
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(s16): 等待并行 Agent 结束后再关闭工作流日志. Target files: s16_workflow_runtime/code.py, tests/test_workflow_goal_lessons.py, s16_workflow_runtime/README.ja.md. 一个并行分支失败时，默认的 `asyncio.gather()` 会立即抛错，但其他分支仍在运行。 工作流提前关闭 journal 并报告失败，导致晚返回的成功结果无法保存，resume 时可能重复调用模型。 (Ref: https://github.com/shareAI-lab/learn-claude-code/pull/571)
